What's wrong with Write-Host in the post?

It writes to the display device of the current session, not the output stream. It doesn't always work as expected when using jobs, events, remoting, logging, redirected display setups (like an IDE), and redirected streams. There are a few specific cases where you might want to use it, but most of those are better served with write-warning or write-verbose any way.
